limitations: The first clipboard assertion ran before its asynchronous handler completed. It was rerun with a bounded wait for the actual Copied state and passed.
One earlier test waited on lazy images without first requesting them and was stopped; final image checks were rerun successfully with bounded waits.
Screenshots after deep anchor navigation were recaptured after layout settled; no early transitional capture is used as QA evidence.
Accessibility checked only for visible structure and tested controls, not full WCAG certification or screen-reader testing.
Print/PDF, other browser engines, real-device behavior, and deployment were not tested.
All final booking/application URLs and public-content approval remain pending.
